task: Mobile-only full-screen home layout (display fills the screen, Mode pinned bottom, Quick Controls + Live Transcript moved into a new slide-up drawer, settings/quick-panel/display icons in a fixed top bar) plus a heavily-styled native <input type=range> replacing the old custom slider (briefly prototyped with vendored noUiSlider, reverted after finding a real feedback-loop bug and per the user's preference for native HTML5 inputs)

public/index.html.summary: Added #quickPanelToggle icon button; wrapped railTop/railStatus/railNote in a new .railTopBar div; moved the Mode section first in railBody and gave it id=modeBar/class=modeBar; wrapped Quick Controls + Live Transcript in a new #quickPanel .drawerContent div with its own header/close button; added #quickPanelBackdrop. Desktop DOM order changed but visual order is restored via CSS  (see controls.css).

public/controller/start-app.js.summary: Added ctx.dom entries and bindings for the new quick-controls drawer (quickPanelToggle/closeQuickPanel/quickPanelBackdrop, setQuickPanelOpen wiring, Escape-key handling). Replaced the old bindRangeSlider-based drag handling for the display-control sliders with a generic bindDragFade() that toggles fade classes on native pointerdown/up/keydown -- no more custom drag-to-position math.

public/controller/view.js.summary: Added setQuickPanelOpen (mirrors setViewPanelOpen for the new drawer). Replaced syncSliderVisual (--slider-value on the input's parentElement) with updateSliderFill (--slider-fill directly on the native input itself, used by the CSS gradient-fill track).

public/controller/range-slider.js.summary: The old custom pointer-based drag-to-position slider implementation is no longer used -- native <input type=range> now handles its own drag/tap/keyboard interaction.

public/styles/controls.css.summary: .modeGrid restyled from a single-column list of full-width rows to a compact icon grid (done in an earlier change); this change adds .drawerContent (display:contents on desktop), .quickControlsSection/.modeBar/.railTranscriptDisclosure order values (1/2/3) to restore desktop's original visual order despite the new DOM structure, and .quickPanelHeader (hidden on desktop).

public/styles/responsive.css.summary: Reworked the <=900px tier from a continuously-scrolling page (previous fix) to a fixed-height (100dvh) flex column: .meetingShell is display:flex, .displayPanel fills remaining space (order:2, flex:1 1 auto), .operatorRail/.railBody go display:contents so .railTopBar (order:1), .modeBar (order:3), and #manualBar (order:4) become independent flex chrome around it. .drawerContent becomes a position:fixed bottom-sheet overlay (transform:translateY(100%), .is-open slides it in) holding Quick Controls + Live Transcript. html/body/#root reverted to height:100dvh/overflow:hidden (no longer need page-level scroll since chrome is fixed-size and the display panel/drawer own their own internal scroll).

public/styles/settings.css.summary: Replaced the custom slider CSS (.sliderVisual/.sliderTrack/.sliderThumb, --slider-points tick-mark gradients) with a heavily-styled native .sliderInput (appearance:none, linear-gradient track fill driven by --slider-fill, big ::-webkit-slider-thumb/::-moz-range-thumb). Added the 'vanish while dragging' fade rules (.is-adjusting-slider / .is-active-slider-field), unchanged in mechanism from the prototype -- still triggered by pointerdown/up, now on the native input directly instead of a slider library's start/end events.

test/public/controller/runtime-test-help.summary: createElement() now gives every fake element a default .style.setProperty/.getPropertyValue (matches real DOM elements, needed since updateSliderFill sets --slider-fill directly on the input). Removed the now-unused range-host/thumb fixture wrapper for the three slider inputs; added realistic min/max attributes to them so percent-fill math in tests matches production.

test/public/app-bootstrap.test.js.summary: Added the same default .style stub to this file's own local createElement (duplicated per-file, not shared) so the real bootstrap flow's updateSliderFill call doesn't throw.

test/public/controller/runtime.test.js.summary: Updated the display-margin visual-thumb test to assert the new --slider-fill contract instead of the removed --slider-value.

test/public/style.test.js.summary: Replaced the old tick-mark/custom-slider CSS assertions with assertions for the native heavily-styled .sliderInput; replaced the old scrolling-page mobile layout assertions with assertions for the new full-screen flex-column home layout.

flow_impact: The mobile <=900px experience changed substantially: full-screen home (display fills the screen), Mode pinned as a bottom bar, Quick Controls + Live Transcript moved into a slide-up drawer opened via a new top-bar icon. Desktop (>900px) is unaffected -- verified live in the browser preview at both 375x812 and 1280x800.
